The Database Was the Bottleneck, Not the API

01 Feb 2026 · Performance, Databases

Problem

API performance degraded under load. Scaling the service didn’t help.

Requests piled up. Response times spiked.

Diagnosis

  • Missing indexes on high-frequency queries
  • N+1 query patterns
  • Connection pool exhaustion

Solution

  • Added targeted indexes
  • Reduced query count per request
  • Batch queries

Result

Lower response times without scaling infrastructure.

Lesson

Scaling compute won’t fix inefficient queries.
